mapper.select: select ID id ,NAME name from REP_FTP_PATH

select EP.id, count(rr.REPORT_CATEGORY) reportCount FROM REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( select * from rep_reveal where CONFIRM_STATUS ='01' and REVEAL_STATUS='01' and STATUS='E' and to_char(REVEAL_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) rr ON EP.ID=rr.REPORT_CATEGORY GROUP BY EP.id

SELECT EP.id, COUNT(rr.REPORT_CATEGORY) reportCount FROM REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ri.REPORT_CATEGORY FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG_DETAIL rild LEFT JOIN REP_INFO ri ON rild.REP_ID = ri.REP_ID WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(rild.STR_EXEC_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rild.EXEC_STATUS = '02' AND rild.STATUS ='E' ) rr ON EP.ID=rr.REPORT_CATEGORY GROUP BY EP.id

SELECT '生成失败' firstCol, EP.id, COUNT(P.REPORT_CATEGORY) reportCount FROM REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RN.REPORT_CATEGORY FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG_DETAIL RDL LEFT JOIN REP_INFO RN ON RDL.REP_ID = RN.REP_ID WHERE RDL.exec_status='02' AND RDL.STATUS='E' AND #{searchDateEnd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} >= to_char(RDL.REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AND to_char(RDL.REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= #{searchDateStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND RDL.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL)P ON EP.ID=P.REPORT_CATEGORY GROUP BY EP.id
UNION ALL SELECT '待确认' firstCol, EP.id, count(rr.REPORT_CATEGORY) reportCount from REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( select * from rep_reveal where CONFIRM_STATUS ='02' and STATUS='E' AND #{searchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} >= to_char(REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AND to_char(REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= #{searchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) rr ON EP.ID=rr.REPORT_CATEGORY GROUP BY EP.id
UNION ALL SELECT '待披露' firstCol, EP.id, count(rr.REPORT_CATEGORY) reportCount FROM REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( select * from rep_reveal where CONFIRM_STATUS ='01' and REVEAL_STATUS='02' and STATUS='E' AND #{searchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} >= to_char(REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AND to_char(REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= #{searchDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) rr ON EP.ID=rr.REPORT_CATEGORY GROUP BY EP.id

SELECT EP.id, COUNT(log.repType) reportCount FROM REP_FTP_PATH EP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rfp.ID repType, rl.REVEAL_END_DATE FROM rep_Expected_Log rl LEFT JOIN REP_INFO ri ON rl.REP_ID = ri.REP_ID LEFT JOIN REP_FTP_PATH rfp ON ri.REPORT_CATEGORY = rfp.ID WHERE to_char(rl.REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')=#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS='E' ) log ON EP.ID=log.repType GROUP BY EP.id

SELECT DISTINCT srm.PAGE_ID FROM SYS_ROLE_MODULE srm LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON srm.ROLE_ID = sur.ROLE_ID WHERE 1=1 and (srm.ELEMENT_ID = 'null' or srm.ELEMENT_ID is null)
and sur.USER_ID = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
